en: If I'm the founder of a company, an early stage company, do I just accept that I'm going to have B tier or C tier AI talent?
zh: 如果我是一家公司的创始人，一家早期公司，我是不是只能接受我将拥有 B 级或 C 级 AI 人才这一事实？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I don't mean that denigratively or rudely or horribly, but there are no anthropic and open AI.
zh: 我不是在贬低、无礼或刻薄，但没有 anthropic 和 open AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, Google can't fricking keep them.
zh: 我是说，Google 该死的都留不住他们。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think it's the wrong framing because if you think about it, when you were building a software company in the age of the PC, you had fourth tier chip talent because you weren't building a chip.
zh: 我认为这种框架是错误的，因为如果你仔细想想，当你在 PC 时代构建一家软件公司时，你拥有的是四流芯片人才，因为你不是在制造芯片。

speaker: Unknown
en: The point is, if you're an AI company and you feel the need to build a frontier model, then yes.
zh: 关键在于，如果你是一家 AI 公司，并且觉得有必要构建一个前沿模型，那么是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've put yourself in direct competition with someone, and if you don't have the good people, you're toast.
zh: 你让自己直接与某人竞争，如果你没有优秀的人才，你就死定了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what you've got to do is make the model a complement and have A-tier talent at UI, A-tier talent at AI implementation, A-tier talent at the things that you have your competitive advantage in.
zh: 所以你必须做的是让模型成为一种互补，并在 UI 方面拥有 A 级人才，在 AI 实施方面拥有 A 级人才，在你具有竞争优势的领域拥有 A 级人才。

speaker: Unknown
en: Even the very best companies that are taking open-weight models and fine-tuning them, they should be experts at fine-tuning, they should be expert on their data domain, but they're probably not going to be as good at kind of building an LLM from scratch as the guys who've been doing it for the last two years, but that's okay.
zh: 即使是那些非常优秀的、使用开放权重模型并对其进行微调的公司，他们应该是微调专家，他们应该是其数据领域的专家，但他们可能不擅长从头开始构建 LLM，不像那些过去两年一直在做这件事的人，但这没关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: One tough thing, though, that is happening for sure is that I think when we started this show, there started to be sort of two tracks on compensation, which is I have to break my salary bands for my AI guys because they're worth so much to Anthropic and OpenAI.
zh: 不过，有一件困难的事情确实正在发生，那就是我认为当我们开始这个节目时，薪酬开始出现两条轨道，即我必须为我的 AI 员工打破薪资等级，因为他们对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 来说太有价值了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now we're seeing three bands of compensation.
zh: 现在我们看到了三个薪酬等级。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're seeing the regular human beings, then we're seeing the AI guys, and then we're seeing the one to five superstars that we're talking about, right, that I have to find a seven-figure package for as an early-stage startup.
zh: 我们看到了普通人，然后我们看到了 AI 人员，然后我们看到了我们正在谈论的一到五位超级明星，对吧，作为一家早期初创公司，我必须为他们提供七位数的薪酬包。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because they're going to get it, right?
zh: 因为他们会得到的，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And we have to provide them everything, the outsized equity, the outsized cash.
zh: 我们必须为他们提供一切，超额的股权，超额的现金。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there are, especially when you talk for folks that are mature, the 100 million and up, ARR guys, 200 million and up, they all have this god tier now of compensation.
zh: 而且，特别是当你谈到那些成熟的人，那些 1 亿及以上的 ARR 人员，2 亿及以上，他们现在都有这个神级的薪酬。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you have the revenue, it's sort of fine, right?
zh: 如果你有收入，那还算可以，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're doing 200 million in revenue, you can have four god tier employees.
zh: 如果你的收入是 2 亿，你可以有四位神级员工。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not going to break your model, but it is something that folks have had to accept.
zh: 这不会破坏你的模型，但这是人们不得不接受的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a bunch of CEOs I work with informally that I'm not an investor with that I work with.
zh: 我有一批非正式合作的公司 CEO，我没有投资他们，但我与他们合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: At that scale, and they've all created god tiers.
zh: 在那个规模上，他们都创造了神级。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're like, I got four guys.
zh: 他们就像，我有四个人。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are the core of my next generation product, okay?
zh: 他们是我下一代产品的核心，好吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: They're all making seven figures.
zh: 他们都赚七位数。

speaker: Unknown
en: They all have equity stakes 10 times what an employee at this late stage would have and the best investment I've made, like this god tier.
zh: 他们拥有的股权份额是这个阶段普通员工的 10 倍，这是我做出的最好的投资，就像这个神级一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it's tough on the rest of the team, right?
zh: 但这对团队的其余人来说很难，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it's not the way we used to do this kumbaya style when you've got this god tier.
zh: 因为当你拥有这个神级时，这不再是我们过去那种 kumbaya 风格的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's tough.
zh: 这很难。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you're not going to pull off a Palantir or an Intercom without a god tier.
zh: 但如果没有神级，你不可能建立一个 Palantir 或 Intercom。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need a Skunkworks and you need a god tier or it ain't going to work.
zh: 你需要一个 Skunkworks，你需要一个神级，否则它不会成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just the siren call of the Anthropic comp is too high.
zh: 只是 Anthropic 薪酬的诱惑太大了。

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenAI just did a secondary of 7 billion, didn't it, this week?
zh: OpenAI 本周刚刚做了一笔 70 亿的二次出售，不是吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Something like that?
zh: 诸如此类？

speaker: Unknown
en: That sounds pretty good to me, guys.
zh: 这对我来说听起来不错，伙计们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Markets and prices are all about incentives and signaling, right?
zh: 市场和价格都是关于激励和信号，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a way of sending real information.
zh: 这是一种发送真实信息的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's no doubt that, you know, I saw the analysis that someone who got a million in stock in Anthropic in 23, it's worth 51 million now.
zh: 毫无疑问，你知道，我看到一项分析，某人在 23 年在 Anthropic 获得了价值 100 万的股票，现在价值 5100 万。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a signal that just ripples through the hiring environment across the entire ecosystem.
zh: 这是一个信号，它会波及整个生态系统的招聘环境。

en: Now, I would remind everyone that that's what's known as a one-in-a-lifetime change.
zh: 现在，我要提醒大家，这就是所谓的一生一次的变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think the person today will be getting 50 times their return.
zh: 我认为今天的人不会获得 50 倍的回报。

speaker: Unknown
en: But whatever, it does have an impact of just distorting what everyone thinks is possible.
zh: 但不管怎样，它确实产生了一种影响，扭曲了每个人认为可能的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we are naturally attracted to narrative around the outliers.
zh: 而且我们自然会被围绕异常值的叙述所吸引。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's not the norm.
zh: 那不是常态。

speaker: Unknown
en: But yes, that is the California gold rush part of the story.
zh: 但是的，这就是故事中的加州淘金热部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're going to see it even more written when the pricing happens.
zh: 当定价发生时，你会看到更多关于它的报道。

speaker: Unknown
en: The only other thing I would just add, if you're not, how do you compete with them, right?
zh: 我想补充的唯一一点是，如果你不是，你怎么与他们竞争，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you compete with that?
zh: 你怎么跟那个竞争？

speaker: Unknown
en: I do think you might have to have a god mode compensation package.
zh: 我确实认为你可能得有一个上帝模式级的薪酬方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: The only thing is, a lot of those jobs, the jobs that you're offered for those jobs, they do, going to Rory's earlier point, they do kind of suck.
zh: 唯一的问题是，很多那些工作，给你提供的那种工作，回到 Rory 之前说的，确实有点烂。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not all Jeff Dean and buddies sitting around in a whiteboard designing the future of Fable, the 7.2.
zh: 他们并不都是 Jeff Dean 和伙伴们围坐在白板前设计 Fable 7.2 的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of these jobs are for folks that aren't quite at that tier, are not that great.
zh: 很多这些工作是给那些还没达到那个层级、没那么优秀的人准备的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's always been the job of a founder is to find those pirates and romantics at the edge
zh: 所以这向来是创始人的工作，就是在边缘找到那些海盗和浪漫主义者

speaker: Unknown
en: That could get it, you know, back when I was a founder, our test was always, did you get an offer at Google?
zh: 你能懂的，你知道，我当那会儿创始人的时候，我们的测试总是，你拿到 Google 的 offer 了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: If someone got an offer at Google back in the day, you knew that they were top 5%.
zh: 如果有人当年拿到了 Google 的 offer，你知道他们是前 5%。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could do the same test today.
zh: 你今天可以做同样的测试。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you get an offer at Anthropic or OpenAI?
zh: 你拿到 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的 offer 了吗？

en: And what was the offer?

en: Well, that flashing thing in Claude they want me to work on, or I'm colorblind, the red or orange thing, I'm going to make a million dollars a year getting that pulse just right, or I got to work on watermarking my first 18 months.
zh: 嗯，Claude 里那个闪烁的东西他们想让我做，或者我是色盲，那个红色或橙色的东西，我要年薪一百万美元把那个脉冲调得正好，或者我得在前 18 个月做水印工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you can find the folks that say, yeah, accounting software would be more fun than that.
zh: 所以你能找到那些说，是啊，会计软件会比那更有趣的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'd like to do LLMs for accountants.
zh: 我想为会计们做 LLM。

speaker: Unknown
en: You've got to interview everyone on planet Earth and you will find someone that doesn't want that job, right?
zh: 你得面试地球上的每个人，你会发现有个人不想要那份工作，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the job.
zh: 这就是工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: But you might have to pay them a lot more than you had to 24 months ago.
zh: 但你可能得付给他们比 24 个月前多得多的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Talent is one bottleneck.
zh: 人才是一个瓶颈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Another bottleneck that I did think was a really interesting news story that came out this week was the backlash going federal when it comes to new data center creation.
zh: 另一个瓶颈，我确实认为本周出炉的一个非常有趣的新闻故事，是关于新建数据中心的抵制蔓延到了联邦层面。

speaker: Unknown
en: Rep Ro Khanna said he will introduce a data center bill of rights that will give local communities the right to say no to AI data centers.
zh: 众议员 Ro Khanna 表示他将提出一项数据中心权利法案，赋予当地社区拒绝 AI 数据中心的权力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes, you go, Rep. Ro Khanna.
zh: 是的，去吧，众议员 Ro Khanna。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's exactly what Xi Jinping is going to say.
zh: 这正是习近平会说的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: The hero of Silicon Valley.
zh: 硅谷的英雄。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, Xi Jinping is going to say, stop you deep-seeking moonshot.
zh: 是的，习近平会说，停止你们的 deep-seeking moonshot。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't want that in this rural community.
zh: 我们不想要这个在乡村社区。

speaker: Unknown
en: What a freaking joke, eh?
zh: 真是个天大的笑话，呃？

speaker: Unknown
en: I have talked with some folks who truly are experts at this.
zh: 我和一些真正是这方面的专家的人聊过。

speaker: Unknown
en: Most folks think that this is pretty lame.
zh: 大多数人认为这相当蹩脚。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is pretty dumb, this NIMBYism.
zh: 这相当蠢，这种 NIMBYism。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's even crazy that Texas is in on it, is in on the NIMBYism.
zh: 甚至德克萨斯州也参与其中，也参与了这种 NIMBYism，这就很疯狂。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think Elon pointed out that the TerraFab has already created 3,000 jobs, but it's only 10% capacity.
zh: 我想 Elon 指出 TerraFab 已经创造了 3000 个工作岗位，但这只是 10% 的产能。

speaker: Unknown
en: It could be 30,000 to kind of get folks to see the other side of it.
zh: 它可能是 30000 个，为了让人们看到它的另一面。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I think folks that are close to it think that there will be enough
zh: 但我认为贴近此事的人认为会有足够的

speaker: Unknown
en: Counties and jurisdictions that want these data centers, that as we push through this and as government gets on the other side, it will ultimately gonna work itself out.
zh: 县和司法管辖区想要这些数据中心，随着我们推动此事以及政府转变立场，它最终会自动解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like this will not be one of the great issues of our time, even though it seems ridiculous today that you don't want these.
zh: 就像这不会成为我们这个时代的重大问题之一，尽管今天看起来很荒谬，你不想要这些。

speaker: Unknown
en: But they are, you know, there's only so many people working at these data centers.
zh: 但它们是，你知道，在这些数据中心工作的人只有那么多。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this one may work itself out.
zh: 但这件事可能会自动解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: At least that's what folks I've talked to that know it more closely than me.
zh: 至少这是那些比我更了解此事的人告诉我的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you not think this will be a material blocker in our speed of deployment?
zh: 你不认为这会是我们部署速度上的一个实质性阻碍吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, we have 50 states, and I don't know how many counties we have.
zh: 嗯，我们有 50 个州，我不知道我们有多少个县。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a lot of counties.
zh: 有很多县。

speaker: Unknown
en: There will be some with water and power that want this business, is the meta point, and that also this backlash isn't going to last, right?
zh: 总会有一些有水和电的地方想要这门生意，这是元观点，而且这种抵制不会持久，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: These are not all destroying our water tables.
zh: 这些并不都是破坏我们的地下水位。

speaker: Unknown
en: These are real jobs.
zh: 这些是真正的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: 300,000, 3,000 jobs for a lot of poor communities.
zh: 300000，3000 个工作岗位，对很多贫困社区来说。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's not mock it.
zh: 别嘲笑它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, this is such an entitled podcast.
zh: 我的意思是，这是一个如此充满特权的播客。

en: Oh, a poor anthropic engineer only made $35 million.
zh: 哦，一个可怜的 anthropic 工程师只赚了 3500 万。

zh: 我的意思是，去该死的狭长地带看看，没人赚 5 万，对吧？

en: So these are not enough jobs, right, to make up for, but these are real jobs with real money, and they're gonna last years and years and years, and they bring a limited amount of real economic benefit, but it is a bummer for places where we should be building these data centers, for sure.
zh: 所以这些工作不够多，对吧，不足以弥补，但这些是真正的工作，有真金白银，而且它们会持续很多很多很多年，它们带来有限的真正经济效益，但对于我们应该建设这些数据中心的地方来说，这确实是个令人扫兴的事，肯定是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not a net positive, it's just a question of will it work itself out in the US, where we do have a nice set of competition here, regulatory competition between states and counties.
zh: 这不是净收益，这只是它在美国能否自行解决的一个问题，我们这里确实有一套不错的竞争，州和县之间的监管竞争。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, the irony of Ro Khanna, you know, the Silicon Valley congressman turning into the, you know, the Marxist wolf in sheep's clothing is pleasing to me, as I would not tend to be on that side of the voting aisle.
zh: 是的，Ro Khanna 的讽刺意味，你知道，那位硅谷议员变成了，你知道，披着羊皮的马克思主义狼，这让我很愉快，因为我不会站在投票通道的那一边。

en: Just watching all the Dems get suckered into thinking he's a moderate has been worth the price of admission as he starts advocating the billionaire's tax.
zh: 看着所有民主党人被忽悠，以为他是一个温和派，这就值回票价了，因为他开始倡导亿万富翁税。

speaker: Unknown

en: But you know, once you're elected congressman, your next step is up.
zh: 但你知道，一旦你当选议员，你的下一步就是向上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the truth is, the way to electoral success probably lies to a fair amount of populism for the next period of time.
zh: 事实上，在未来一段时期，选举成功的道路可能需要相当程度的民粹主义。

speaker: Unknown
en: So on the data science, I think...
zh: 所以在数据科学方面，我认为……

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, I saw a good piece, I think, in Atlantic or something, really, just talking to people, you know, in the areas wrestling with these issues.
zh: 你知道，我看到了一篇好文章，我想是在《大西洋月刊》之类的，真的，只是和人们交谈，你知道，在那些正在努力解决这些问题的地方。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it was a very interesting point.
zh: 这是一个非常有趣的观点。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was much less even AI is awful and much more, I don't know what I'm getting here.
zh: 这甚至不是 AI 很糟糕，而更多的是，我不知道我在这里得到了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's all very opaque.
zh: 这一切都很不透明。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the deal?
zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think if tech wants to get this stuff done, there's two risks here.
zh: 我认为如果科技界想要做成这些事情，这里有两个风险。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they're almost opposite each other because it's...
zh: 它们几乎相反，因为它是……

en: If you want to get local support, you've got to figure out what's the package that moves it for them.

en: And you're seeing that now.

en: So I think there is some wood to chop technically.
